name: Wildmane Water Well
summary: Wildmane Water Well lies under threat as poisoned water endangers Mulgore’s northern plains and the herds that depend on it.

sections.title: A Lifeblood Under Siege
sections.body: Sacred wells sustain the tauren and their wandering kodo herds across Mulgore. Wildmane Water Well lies at the northern edge of the plains, beyond Thunder Bluff’s shadow. Venture Company goblins have poisoned its water to control the regional supply. A totem crafted by the tauren is needed to cleanse the well and make its water pure again.

faq.q: Where is the Wildmane Water Well located?
faq.answer: Wildmane Water Well lies on Mulgore’s plains, directly north of Thunder Bluff’s mesas. It is the northernmost of the sacred wells that sustain the region.

faq.q: Why is the well important to the tauren?
aliases: why do tauren care about the well
faq.answer: Fresh water sustains life on the plains. The tauren hold the wells sacred because they supply settlements, traveling hunters and the kodo herds roaming Mulgore.

faq.q: Who has tried to sabotage or control the well?
faq.answer: Venture Company goblins have poisoned Wildmane Water Well to control Mulgore’s water supply. The tauren can cleanse it with a sacred totem.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know Mulgore’s sacred wells are gifts from the Earth Mother. Defending Wildmane Water Well from defilement and poison is a sacred duty for every young brave.
As a druid, you know goblins threaten the plains’ balance by trying to corrupt Mulgore’s fresh water. Remain vigilant, and cleanse and heal the land.
